text:
tariq: Heads-up — new hires hit a reproducible hang in the sample app pagination flow. Looks like client-side throttle + aggressive retries cause the paginator to stall.

olivia: Oof. Is this the TS sample that does parallel fetches with pageSize=200?

tariq: Yep. Local repro steps: start sample with --parallel=6 --page-size=200, then hit CTRL+C to restart a couple times. After a quick burst of 429s from the API, the local SDK goes into a long quiet period where no pages emit.

olivia: Can you paste the SDK logs? We changed the default RetryPolicy in 0.8, might be related.

tariq: Logs (trimmed):

```
[2026-03-21T09:03:10Z] INFO fetcher: requesting page=3
[2026-03-21T09:03:10Z] WARN http: 429 (x-retry-after=2)
[2026-03-21T09:03:10Z] INFO throttle: drained tokens=0
[2026-03-21T09:03:12Z] INFO retry: sleeping 2000ms (attempt=1)
[2026-03-21T09:03:13Z] INFO throttle: reclaimed tokens=1
[2026-03-21T09:03:43Z] INFO paginator: waiting for token lease
```

olivia: That gap between reclaimed tokens and waiting looks like the token-bucket refill interval is too coarse for concurrent workers. If each worker blocks trying to get N tokens, they'll all block until refill.

ben_ops: tagging @sdk-team — default sample app concurrency combined with older SDK defaults is risky for onboarding. We should either pin SDK >=0.8 in the quickstart image or lower sample concurrency.

tariq: I'm on sdk-js v0.7.2 in the sample container. Does 0.8 change refill behavior?

olivia: Yes — v0.8 added jitter + per-paginator semaphore so workers can get 1 token without starving others; it also supports a small burst allowance. That should prevent the 30s stalls.

ben_ops: Quick mitigation: change sample to env REDWOOD_PAGE_CONCURRENCY=2 and bump bundled sdk to ^0.8. Also add a note: "If you see long pauses during pagination, lower concurrency or upgrade SDK."

tariq: Will open a tiny PR with: 1) update package.json sdk-js -> ^0.8.0 2) set default concurrency to 2 3) add a repro script in scripts/heavy-repro.sh

sdk-bot: Created task #4192: "sample: pagination stalls with old SDK token-bucket defaults" — https://redwood/tasks/4192

olivia: Can we also add a short section in the onboarding README explaining parity differences across SDKs (notable: token-bucket defaults, retry headers to respect x-retry-after, and paginator permits)? New hires keep assuming it's a server bug.

ben_ops: Agreed. Also add example ThrottleConfig snippet in README for both low-latency (dev) and high-throughput (prod) cases. Example: {maxTokens:16, refillMs:100, burst:4, jitter:true}.

tariq: PR opened: https://redwood/pr/800 — includes SDK update, default concurrency change, repro, and README note. Asking for review from @olivia and @ben_ops.

olivia: reviewing now. small nit: name the env var REDWOOD_PAGINATOR_CONCURRENCY to match other samples.

ben_ops: :+1: once merged, we'll push new sample image to quickstart and add a short line in the onboarding checklist so PMs know to try the repro if someone reports flakiness.

tariq: Thanks. Filing a follow-up playbook entry referencing task #4192.
